# 2.5.6 Concurrent Input Mechanisms (Level AAA)

- Principle: 2 Operable
- Guideline: 2.5 Input Modalities
- Level: AAA
- Versions: 2.1, 2.2
- Understanding: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/concurrent-input-mechanisms.html
- Specification: https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#concurrent-input-mechanisms

## Normative text

Web content does not restrict use of input modalities available on a platform except where the restriction is [essential](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#dfn-essential), required to ensure the security of the content, or required to respect user settings.

## Sufficient techniques

- Only using high-level, input-agnostic event handlers, such as `focus`, `blur`, `click`, in Javascript (Potential future technique)
- Registering event handlers for keyboard/keyboard-like and pointer inputs simultaneously in Javascript; see [Example 1 in Pointer Events Level 2](https://www.w3.org/TR/pointerevents2/#example_1) (Potential future technique)

## Failures

- F98: Failure due to interactions being limited to touch-only on touchscreen devices
